findings.title: Round-2 fixes did not propagate into the workstream plannedItems and the sweep constraint — six machine-rendered task items still contradict the same package's fixed requirement/AC/write layers
findings.detail: Residue of F-1/F-2/F-4/F-6/F-7. The authoritative layers of revision 2 are correct (REQ-BE-SETTINGS BUILD wording plan.manifest.json:39; deps.py in WS-BE-SETTINGS writes plan.manifest.json:148; features/index.ts + auth adapter in WS-FE-SETTINGS-LOGIC writes plan.manifest.json:313-314,319; ws/own.ts in WS-FE-SETTINGS-UI writes plan.manifest.json:392-393; contacts files plan.manifest.json:151,158; viewer-own-badge AC plan.manifest.json:461; REQ-FE-THEME color-only + literals gate plan.manifest.json:53). But the plannedItems — the worker's rendered task list — still carry round-1 semantics: (a) WS-FE-SETTINGS-LOGIC plannedItem plan.manifest.json:365 'consumer-side setter, features/index.ts untouched here' DIRECTLY contradicts the workstream's own writes (plan.manifest.json:319) and the pinned AC ('composition-root seam (features/index.ts wiring — pinned)', acceptance-criteria.md:12) — a worker honoring the planned item skips the wiring and the fetchUser/rejoin seams never function (the exact F-2 failure mode); (b) WS-BE-SETTINGS plannedItem plan.manifest.json:219 still says 'VERIFY core/security.py + deps.py consume token_version' against the REQ's BUILD; (c) plannedItems plan.manifest.json:224 ('peer unread preserved') and :225 ('peer-facing unread') instruct the WRONG test against the pinned viewer-own-badge AC (plan.manifest.json:461, acceptance-criteria.md:10); (d) WS-FE-THEME plannedItems plan.manifest.json:295 ('palette/metric tokens declared as :root CSS custom properties') and :297 (grep gate '$color tokens' only) contradict the color-only scope and the both-classes gate pinned in plan.manifest.json:53 and acceptance-criteria.md:11; (e) constraint plan.manifest.json:99 still words the gate '$tokens ... outside libs/scrollbar exemptions' — literals uncovered, exemption list wrong.
findings.requiredFix: Mechanical propagation only (no design change): rewrite plannedItems at plan.manifest.json:219 (BUILD the ver comparison in get_current_user; keep the 401-after pin), :224-225 (skip mark_read when the VIEWER's flag is false; pin the viewer's own unread badge staying after history load, contrast with on), :295 (COLOR tokens only; metrics stay compile-time SCSS), :297 and the constraint at :99 (gate covers $color tokens AND raw hex/rgb() literals; exemption set = variable.scss, utils/mixins.scss, utils/scrollbar.scss, libs/**), :363 (user shape adds send_read_receipts) and :365 (fetchUser/rejoin injected via the composition root features/index.ts — this workstream wires it), and add the ws/own.ts delivery-hook instruction to the WS-FE-SETTINGS-UI planned item at :442. Copy the already-fixed REQ/AC wording verbatim.

implementationQuality.summary: Ownership substance of all ten round-1 findings is verified CLOSED in revision 2: deps.py moved readOnly->writes (plan.manifest.json:148,164-169); contacts repository/service added (:151,:158); auth adapter + ports + composition root added to WS-FE-SETTINGS-LOGIC (:313-314,:319); ws/own.ts + ws.test.ts added to WS-FE-SETTINGS-UI (:392-393); write-set disjointness re-verified with the five new paths (no path in two roles, no readOnly/write overlap); completeness-check PASS on revision 2 (planDigest 9744e352..., zero blockers). But the layers workers execute against were not updated: six plannedItems and the sweep constraint (F-11) plus the entirety of plan.md (F-12) still instruct the round-1 behavior — worst case the LOGIC worker is told 'features/index.ts untouched here' (:365) while the workstream's own writes and the pinned AC require wiring it there, and the BE worker is told to write a 'peer-facing unread' test (:225) the pinned AC forbids. Mechanical text propagation closes all of it; no design change is needed.

residualRisk.summary: SEC-AUTH-MUTATIONS is now backed by mechanism and ownership: the ver comparison is BUILT in get_current_user with deps.py writable and the 401-after pinned (plan.manifest.json:39,148; acceptance-criteria.md:10) — this also gives change_password real cross-device access-token kill. Budgets reconciled (F-10 closed). Migration posture unchanged and sound (additive 011, explicit downgrade target, 001-010 forbidden). Remaining exposure is execution-confusion risk from the contradictory stale text (F-11/F-12), not design risk — hence CHANGES_REQUIRED rather than BLOCKED.

rounds.summary: Structural completeness-check PASS (planDigest 053d5397..., zero blockers) and the previously-fixed write-set disjointness verified clean (no path in two roles; THEME owns all pre-existing scss, UI only the new settings-sections.scss + _all.scss), but six majors block freeze. F-1: the access-token path never compares the 'ver' claim to users.token_version (core/deps.py:59-67; comparison exists only in rotate_refresh_token, services/auth.py:70) — the plan's 'VERIFY' resolves to BUILD yet core/deps.py sits in WS-BE-SETTINGS readOnly, making the pinned logout-all 401-after unachievable within ownership. F-2: toAuthUser (features/auth/api/own.ts:30-42) synthesizes display_name=email/phone='' and drops send_read_receipts, so the plan's own fetchUser-refresh would revert Account edits and the Privacy toggle has no initial state; the fetchUser and rejoinChat cross-feature seams both require the unowned composition root features/index.ts (guard blocks features/profile -> features/auth|chats). F-3: 'on WS message' sound/notifications are only observable in the unowned features/chats/ws/own.ts:181-193 for background chats (Messenger's selector reads just the open chat, messenger.ts:659-683). F-4: the read marker is self-facing only (chat_last_reads feeds solely the caller's unread_counts, repositories/chats.py:124-149) — 'others keep seeing unread'/'peer unread preserved' is undeliverable; reword to the viewer's own badge and non-goal sender-visible receipts. F-5: the /contacts fallback needs unowned repositories/contacts.py + services/contacts.py (list_for_owner:41-52 selects no display_name). F-6: the theme grep gate covers $tokens only while ~27 raw rgb()/hex literals persist in component files, utils/mixins.scss is wrongly called stylelint-excluded, and the light-scrollbar-in-dark-mode artifact is unstated. Minors: F-7 metrics (esp. $tablet/$desktop in @media arithmetic) must stay compile-time; F-8 'DM titles improve' is false (create_dm denormalizes at creation, services/chats.py:98-101); F-9 Form cannot render read-only rows — specify plain-markup rows in the owned profile.hbs; F-10 wall-clock budgets do not reconcile (16200+3600 vs maxRunWallSeconds 18000). All correctable within intent; round 2 available within maxRounds 2.

Revision 2 (planDigest 9744e352deefd02c872f8f06376a60d4aa2c487ac4fd0ae11dcc1670e9291349, completeness-check PASS re-run by this reviewer) closes the SUBSTANCE of all ten round-1 findings at the ownership and binding-criteria layers, verified against source: F-1 deps.py readOnly->writes + BUILD wording with correct citations (plan.manifest.json:39,148; acceptance-criteria.md:10; final gate :566); F-2 auth/api/own.ts + auth/ports.ts + features/index.ts granted (plan.manifest.json:313-314,319) with the real-mapping and composition-seam pins in AC-FE-SETTINGS-LOGIC (acceptance-criteria.md:12); F-3 ws/own.ts + ws.test.ts granted (:392-393); F-4 viewer-own-badge semantics + sender-visible-receipts non-goal in REQ/AC (:39,:461; acceptance-criteria.md:10); F-5 contacts repository/service granted (:151,:158); F-6 both-classes gate + exemption set + scrollbar artifact in REQ-FE-THEME and the AC row (:53; acceptance-criteria.md:11); F-7 color-only scoping (:53; acceptance-criteria.md:11); F-8 DM-title denormalization corrected with the owned create_dm option (:39); F-10 budgets reconciled (21600/16200/16200/3600). Write-set disjointness re-verified with the five new paths; nothing new broke. NOT closed: the fixes were not propagated to the worker-facing layers — plan.md and developer-overview.md are byte-identical to revision 1, six plannedItems and the sweep constraint still carry round-1 semantics (F-11), including two direct contradictions a worker could follow into failure ('features/index.ts untouched here' at plan.manifest.json:365 vs the workstream's own writes and the pinned AC; 'peer-facing unread' test instructions at :224-225 vs the pinned viewer-own-badge AC; $token-only wave gate at :297/:99 vs the pinned both-classes gate). F-12 plan.md unrevised in full; F-13 developer-overview unrevised; F-14 stale copies (AC details paragraph + operator smoke note 'keeps a peer's unread', manifest REQ-FE-SETTINGS-LOGIC description and AC statement copy, missing nonGoals entry). All four residuals are mechanical text propagation of wording that already exists in the corrected layers — no design or ownership change remains. After a revision 3 amendment, a focused confirmation against these exact spots suffices (the contacts round-3 precedent); with maxPlanReviewRounds 2 exhausted, the controller decides the amendment route.
